definitions.explanation: The act of passing along information, instructions, or signals from one person or place to another. More formal than simply 伝える.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝達|でんたつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The transmission of information was delayed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伝達|でんたつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{災害時|さいがいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{伝達|でんたつ}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おくべきだ。
examples.english: We should confirm the means of communication in advance for times of disaster.

notes:
A formal word used in organizational, military, and scientific contexts. In biology, ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{伝達|でんたつ} refers to nerve signal transmission. In organizations, it emphasizes the systematic passing of information down a chain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{伝達|でんたつ} (information transmission)
- ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧{伝達|でんたつ} (transmission of orders)
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧{伝達|でんたつ} (nerve transmission)
- {伝達|でんたつ}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (matters to be communicated)
- {伝達|でんたつ}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧ (means of communication)
